integrity: Mathematical statement and exact script are supplied; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only Desarguesian finite affine planes of prime-power order q>=3; integral module structure is given but no integral quotient torsion or full affine collineation decomposition is claimed. The original nonequivariant Rips homotopy type is published prior work. Three finite-field tests supplement, but do not replace, the universal proof.
title: Translation representations and a rational quotient transition for affine-plane Rips complexes
